title: Attempt Two
description: A customer's card is declined on the first try, so they retry with a better card. Both attempts should be preserved in the invoice's history, in order, and the invoice should only flip to paid once the second one lands.
successCondition: Create an invoice. POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay with cardNumber 4000000000000002 returns 200 with payment.status "declined", attemptNumber 1, and the returned invoice.status still "open". A second POST with a well-formed non-decline/timeout card returns 200 with payment.status "succeeded", attemptNumber 2, and invoice.status now "paid". GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments returns both attempts, oldest first, with attemptNumber 1 and 2 respectively.
hints: The declined attempt leaves the invoice open specifically so a retry is possible — that's FR-1004, documented in docs/api/billing.md.
attemptNumber is derived from a count of prior Payment rows for that invoice, so ordering matters — don't fire the two pay calls concurrently.
